## Checklist

- [ ] I added the entry to the matching catalog in `index.ts`.
- [ ] The ID is unique, lowercase, and kebab-case.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm typecheck`.
- [ ] I included screenshots for a visual theme when possible.
- [ ] The source is readable and contains no generated or minified code.
- [ ] Plugin teardown removes everything the plugin adds.
- [ ] I did not add external tracking or collect account data.
